#!/usr/bin/env bash
# search_nodes.qmd — Search knowledge node files (global + local) by query string.
#
# Uses QMD BM25 search when available, falls back to grep.
# Add --semantic flag for vector similarity search (requires qmd + embeddings).
#
# Scopes to BOTH:
#   1. Global vault: akms-global-nodes collection (or $AKMS_GLOBAL_VAULT dir)
#   2. Local nodes:  akms-<repo>-local-nodes collection (or knowledge/local-nodes/ dir)
#
# Usage: run_qmd.sh search_nodes "query string" [--semantic]

set -euo pipefail

QUERY="${1:?Usage: search_nodes <query> [--semantic]}"
SEMANTIC="${2:-}"

# Resolve paths
GLOBAL_VAULT="${AKMS_GLOBAL_VAULT:-$HOME/.claude/akms/nodes}"
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
LOCAL_NODES="$REPO_ROOT/knowledge/local-nodes"
REPO_NAME="$(basename "$REPO_ROOT")"

# Detect qmd availability
HAS_QMD=false
if command -v qmd &>/dev/null; then
    HAS_QMD=true
fi

# Build search command based on mode
_qmd_search() {
    local collection="$1"
    local query="$2"
    if [ "$SEMANTIC" = "--semantic" ]; then
        qmd search "$query" --semantic --collection "$collection"
    else
        qmd search "$query" --collection "$collection"
    fi
}

_grep_fallback() {
    local dir="$1"
    local query="$2"
    grep -ril --include="*.md" "$query" "$dir" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no matches)"
}

# ── Global Nodes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
echo "=== Global Nodes ==="
if [ "$HAS_QMD" = true ]; then
    _qmd_search "akms-global-nodes" "$QUERY" 2>/dev/null || {
        echo "(qmd collection 'akms-global-nodes' not found — falling back to grep)"
        if [ -d "$GLOBAL_VAULT" ]; then
            _grep_fallback "$GLOBAL_VAULT" "$QUERY"
        else
            echo "(vault not found at $GLOBAL_VAULT)"
        fi
    }
else
    echo "(qmd not installed — using grep fallback)"
    if [ -d "$GLOBAL_VAULT" ]; then
        _grep_fallback "$GLOBAL_VAULT" "$QUERY"
    else
        echo "(vault not found at $GLOBAL_VAULT)"
    fi
fi

echo ""

# ── Local Nodes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
echo "=== Local Nodes ==="
if [ "$HAS_QMD" = true ]; then
    _qmd_search "akms-${REPO_NAME}-local-nodes" "$QUERY" 2>/dev/null || {
        echo "(qmd collection 'akms-${REPO_NAME}-local-nodes' not found — falling back to grep)"
        if [ -d "$LOCAL_NODES" ]; then
            _grep_fallback "$LOCAL_NODES" "$QUERY"
        else
            echo "(no local nodes directory)"
        fi
    }
else
    if [ -d "$LOCAL_NODES" ]; then
        _grep_fallback "$LOCAL_NODES" "$QUERY"
    else
        echo "(no local nodes directory)"
    fi
fi
